description: This file defines a CartAdapter class for displaying shopping cart items within a RecyclerView in an Android application. It manages the presentation of cart items, binding product information and quantity to the respective views.

classes.name: CartAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class for managing and displaying shopping cart items in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: VH
classes.description: ViewHolder inner class for binding individual cart item views.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the list of cart items and refreshes the RecyclerView.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates new ViewHolder instances by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for the item at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items in the cart.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a ShopRepository.CartItem object to the view components in VH.
